title: Turkey Vulture
author: G. McGrane
changes: Turkey vulture (Cathartes aura) hisses. Trimmed to 18.45–19.78 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.6 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
